up: Return a detailed list of all exact IC50 activity records for human Mitogen-activated protein kinase 14 (p38 MAPK). For each matching activity record, report the following: the ChEMBL ID of the compound, the canonical SMILES of the compound, the compound key from the specific test record, the PubMed ID or DOI of the source document, the assay description, the target ChEMBL ID, the target name, and the exact IC50 value in nM. Ensure that only records where the standard value is an exact measurement (standard_relation is '=') and the standard units are nM are included.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, a.standard_value AS ic50_nm FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.pref_name = 'Mitogen-activated protein kinase 14' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '='
